response.original_title: SPYAIR Just Like This 2025 -HISTORY of ANIME-
response.overview: Originally launched in earnest at the foot of Mount Fuji in 2015 and since becoming SPYAIR's annual solo outdoor live event, "JUST LIKE THIS" marks its tenth year with its first-ever two-day performance held on September 27 and 28, 2025, at Kawaguchiko Stella Theater in Yamanashi Prefecture. Day one is themed around past "JUST LIKE THIS" performances, while day two focuses on SPYAIR's past anime songs, with different setlists for each day commemorating the tenth anniversary. The event features a special setlist unique to this occasion, including the theme song written specifically for the event, "Bring the Beat Back," the major hit "Orange," the Boat Race 2025 commercial song "Chase the Shine," along with representative songs and live rarities.
